liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): The opening Shakedown Street features some very interesting effects [22]
- **Loser** (1 review): The performance of Loser is described as stupendous [25]
- **Supplication** (1 review): Supplication comes out blazing with fearless intensity, making up for vocal flubs [29]
- **Fire On the Mountain** (1 review): The transition into Fire On the Mountain was super juicy and amazing [32]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): By Throwing Stones, Bobby's voice is shot [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-04-26.fob.chrisk-kyleh.ford.78773.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-04-26.149898.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 170 min [2]
- **gd1984-04-26.149636.beyerm201mke2002.holbrook.flac1644**: source not stated; 20 songs; 174 min [4]
- **gd1984-04-26.mtx.seamons.fix.92297.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 179 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [6]
- **gd1984-04-26.mtx.seamons.91809.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 179 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [7]. Said about its sound: The mix is perfect on this matrix; the band is a well-oiled machine [32]
- **gd1984-04-26.sbd.miller.91432.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 179 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [8]. Said about its sound: Miller SBD is very clean for the era; Jerry's vocals are surprisingly good; Very nice sound quality; high energy and smoking right to the end [22][33]
- **gd1984-04-26.123621.chasingwilma.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 173 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [19]. Said about its sound: High-quality audience recording captures the show's sounds and energy better than SBD [31]
- **gd1984-04-26.109441.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [20]. Said about its sound: Good audience recording, though the band sounds a little tired [26]

## Around the show

- Reviewer danced through Shakedown with eyes closed, feeling the shared love [23]
- Reviewer spent the night in jail across the street for peddling without a license [26]
- Mounted police ran the reviewer and his buddy out of the parking lot [27]
- Show trumps better-known spring 1984 performances, ranking among the year's tops [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-04-26.fob.chrisk-kyleh.ford.78773.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Chris K / Kyle H.; source: { Sennheiser MKE 2002 (binaural, head worn) > Sony D5 > Sony D5 > Maxell XLII-S (no Dolby) / Beyer M201s (hyper cards, X-Y) > Sony TC D5M > TDK MA90 (no Dolby)… [1]. Also: Alex Ford transferred, edited, and uploaded the files to bt.etree.org on 10/5/2006; Shakedown Street was patched with a Neumann source provided by Jake Feinberg [1]
- **gd1984-04-26.149898.mke2002.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew: Chris Kidwell; Sean Murtha; Tom Pinney; Kyle Holbrook; Gary Steel; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source: MAUD CA: Sennheiser MKE2002 Binaurals mounted on dummy head 50 feet from stage DFC >Sony TCD6M > TDK MA 90s x2.5 No Dolby - Master copy from 2nd deck… [2]. Also: CC Rider until Supplication had channel dropout issues on the master cassette [2]
- **gd1984-04-26.149636.beyerm201mke2002.holbrook.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by: Executive Crew: Chris Kidwell; Sean Murtha; Tom Pinney; Kyle Holbrook; Gary Steele; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source: set 1: MAUD CA: Sennheiser MKE2002 Binaurals mounted on dummy head 50 feet from stage DFC >Sony TCD6M > TDK MA 90s No Dolby - Master copy from 2nd deck… [4]. Also: CC Rider until Supplication had channel dropout issues on the master cassette [4]
- **gd1984-04-26.mtx.seamons.fix.92297.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See Notes; transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: See Notes [6]. Also: CM and JHS re-mastered the old tapes, making them sound awesome; Charlie Miller handled all transfers and mastering for the matrix mix; Set I used Sennheiser MKE 2002 binaural mics; Set II used Beyer M201s in X-Y [6][29]
- **gd1984-04-26.mtx.seamons.91809.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: SBD/2 AUD (About 60%/40%) [7]
- **gd1984-04-26.sbd.miller.91432.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D [8]
- **gd1984-04-26.123621.chasingwilma.flac24**: taped by chasingwilma; transferred by chasingwilma; source: source: (3)audio technica atm11 fob> optimus> d-5; conversion: sony tc we435>sony pcm m-10 24bit/96khz> soundforge> cdwave> traders little helper encoding… [19]
- **gd1984-04-26.109441.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Sennheiser 441's & 1 Beyer M160 microphones (15th row) > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TCD5M (Dolby on)- analog master cassettes; [20]
